final.memo:
Our investment in the Company was predicated on a fundamental disconnect between the underlying profitable business and the market's reaction to a high-profile, controversy-driven short attack [D01, D08]. Since establishing our position in the low $30s, the stock has experienced a significant technical repricing, fueled by robust operating performance and a squeeze on the short side [D01, D04, D07]. The February 19 earnings release confirming double-digit growth in sales and volume points provides evidence of the business's current resilience [D03].

However, our discipline requires us to distinguish between a successful tactical event and a long-term compounder. While strong results are welcome, they do not serve as a final resolution to the ongoing regulatory and business-model critiques that persist regardless of quarterly EPS beats [D01, D03, D05]. A crowded trade on both the long and short sides creates volatility that is increasingly decoupled from the fundamentals we initially underwrote [D01, D06].

We are not in the business of winning public arguments or holding through indefinite regulatory uncertainty when the primary technical edge has been captured [D01]. As the catalyst is now largely spent, we are trimming our position to lock in gains and rotate capital toward higher-conviction, asymmetric opportunities. We will continue to monitor the regulatory environment, but our conviction in this specific trade has been dampened by the successful realization of our entry thesis [D04, D05].
